title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Jaundice
intro: Herbal creams for Jaundice are topical preparations made from natural herbs and plants that are applied directly to the skin to help treat and manage jaundice symptoms. These creams have been shown to provide several benefits, including reducing bilirubin levels, soothing skin irritation, and promoting liver health. Examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat jaundice include Silymarin cream, which is extracted from the milk thistle plant and helps to protect the liver from damage; Turmeric cream, which contains curcumin and has anti-inflammatory properties; and Dandelion root cream, which stimulates liver function and promotes bile production. Additionally, other herbal creams such as Ginger, Peppermint, and Calendula have also been used to help alleviate symptoms associated with jaundice, including nausea, vomiting, and skin rashes.
